newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM Cargo to start Vienna freighter flight.
newsitem.headline: KLM Cargo to start Vienna freighter flight.

text.p: KLM Cargo said that from October 1, it will add Vienna to its scheduled full freighter destinations with a twice weekly flight via its Linz sub-hub.
The air cargo wing of KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV said in a statement that the Wednesday and Thursday service will used a Lockheed Electra owned by the Fred Olsen group.
An airline spokesman told Reuters the Electra will depart Schiphol at 1835 local time with a stopover at Linz, arriving in Vienna at 2210.

KLM said Vienna is developing as a major distribution gateway to the fast expanding east European market where KLM Cargo has already a strong position. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
